title: A Cap at Ten
lines: Peg got in bed at ten.
"The tan cap is not in the bed," said Peg.
"I am up at ten," said Peg.
Ted met Nan at a bin.
Nan and Ted got the bin up.
Nan got a cap in the bin!
Ted got the cap to Peg.
scoring_note: This passage says "is not", "I am". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "isn't" or "I'm" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
